findings.quote: Reading the acceleration between t = 2 s and t = 8 s directly off the middle segment slope alone instead of using the overall change in velocity over that interval.
findings.note: Between t = 2 s and t = 8 s the velocity-time graph is one straight segment from (2, 4) to (8, -8), so its slope is exactly -2 m/s^2, the same value the solution obtains. Reading that slope directly is a correct method, not a mistake, and the entry names no wrong number it could produce.
findings.fix: Dividing the velocity change by the total time 8 s instead of by the 6 s interval from t = 2 s to t = 8 s gives -1.5 m/s2 instead of -2 m/s2.
